PART I
RELEVANCY OF FACTS
CHAPTER I
PRELIMINARY
2. Definitions.
(1) In this Adhiniyam, unless the context otherwise requires—
(a) Court includes all Judges and Magistrates;
(b) conclusive proof has the meaning assigned to that expression.
(2) Expressions used in this Adhiniyam shall be read in their statutory context.
Provided that the text of the document is preserved.
Explanation 1.— Electronic and digital records are included in the description of documents.
Illustrations.
(a) A writing is a document.
(b) A map or plan is a document.
3. Evidence may be given of facts in issue and relevant facts.
For the reference-extraction fixture, see section 2.
